title: Desert Trotters
desc: Beyond an uninhabited expanse to the far east known as the Forbidden Lands. The Hunter joins the expedition team aboard a sandship. Their mission: to aid the Keepers, and investigate the unidentified monster that destroyed the people's village, known as the White Wraith.

title: Back to Camp
desc: After her rescue, the young girl, Nona, explains that her brother lured away a Chatacabra to protect her. The Hunter slays the monster and escorts the young man, Y'sai, back to Base Camp.

title: The Beginning
desc: Since the underground passage Nata escaped through collapsed, the expedition team must seek a path to the Keepers' village topside. For now, the Hunter is tasked with escorting Nona and Y'sai home to their village while the others finish setting up Base Camp.

title: Village of Whispering Winds

title: To the Forest
desc: The Avis Unit canvasses Kunafa, but find no leads on the Keepers. Instead, they learn from the village Elder that large monsters known as Doshaguma are encroaching on the human settlement. Concerned, the Hunter makes for the forest to investigate.

title: Forest Findings

title: The Investigation Continues
desc: With the Congalala defeated at the Wudwuds' request, the Hunter succeeds in reclaiming the Pop-up Camp, allowing the Doshaguma investigation to continue.

title: A Hunter's Pride
desc: The Hunter's investigation in the woods reveals that the Doshaguma have overcome their fear of humans and formed a pack, led by an alpha. It's only a matter of time before they descend on Kunafa. The Avis Unit races back to warn the village.

title: A Hunter's Pride
desc: The Hunter's investigation in the woods reveals that the Doshaguma have overcome their fear of humans and formed a pack, led by an alpha. It's only a matter of time before they descend on Kunafa. The Avis Unit races back to warn the village.

title: Pursuit of Solitude
desc: After the Hunter drives the Doshaguma pack away from Kunafa and hunts its alpha, the village Elder grants the expedition team free access to the village. The Avis Unit now rides to the forest to hear Olivia's progress on the search for the White Wraith.

title: Beyond the Deluge
desc: The Avis Unit learns that Olivia and Erik's investigation into the White Wraith has brought them into the remotest reaches of the forest. Eager to hear their report and deliver Seikret for the pair's use, they ride through the rain into the forest's depths...

title: A Looming Shadow
desc: Nata confirms that the monster they saw through the downpour was their target— the White Wraith. The boy's long- suppressed rage boils to the surface and erupts. With the weather cleared and the monster nowhere in sight, the Avis Unit makes for the forest in search of its trail.

title: Toward Fervent Fields
desc: Zatoh tells of a land where the earth bleeds oil and its artisans who practice ancient crafting techniques. The Avis Unit sets out to meet the three tribes he spoke of to learn their ways and—with any luck—to hear word of the Keepers.

title: Toward Fervent Fields
desc: Zatoh tells of a land where the earth bleeds oil and its artisans who practice ancient crafting techniques. The Avis Unit sets out to meet the three tribes he spoke of to learn their ways and—with any luck—to hear word of the Keepers.

title: An Unforeseen Storm
desc: Zatoh receives word from Kunafa that an unseasonable sandstorm is bound for the village and hastens back to his home. Suspecting that the White Wraith may be in the storm's wake, the Hunter and company set out for its epicenter.

title: The Eye of the Storm
desc: Suspecting that the White Wraith might appear at the heart of the sandstorm, the Hunter's unit hurries to the Wind's Gasp...

title: A Desolate Destination
desc: At the Wind's Gasp, the Hunter and company witness the White Wraith draining some form of energy from another monster before taking flight. They return to Azuz in pursuit.

title: Hopes of Home
desc: The people of Azuz lead the way to what appears to be an underground passage. Nata recognizes it immediately—beyond it lies the Keepers' village. The boy's heart soars at the prospect of seeing his home once more.

title: A Disquieting Dawn
desc: Suspecting that the Landspine is a man-made structure closely tied to the strange energy they've witnessed, the Hunter and company make for Azuz to attempt to dissuade Werner from moving forward with its repair.

title: Long-forgotten Flame
desc: Perhaps due to the recent repairs to the Landspine, a sudden Firespring hits Azuz. The sudden change stokes the Everforge into an uncontrollable frenzy. The fury of nearby Ajarakan is equally sparked, and the Hunter springs into action to protect the village.

title: Born from the Flame
desc: With the threat to Azuz abated, the expedition team reflects on their recent discoveries: the suspected man-made Landspine, and the likelihood that the region's unique ecological cycle derives from it. They return to the first Base Camp to discuss their next steps.

title: The Faithful Keepers
desc: After the events in Azuz, it has become clear that the Landspine is likely an artificial structure from which the region derives its unique ecological cycle. With the ice that blocked the underground passage now melted, the Avis Unit once again makes for the Keepers' village.

title: The Faithful Keepers

title: Indomitable Spirit
desc: The Hunter repels the White Wraith—the Guardian Arkveld. But Tasheen expresses shock upon learning that a monster with no need to feed was engaging in predation. He claims the so-called Allhearken may have answers, therein deciding the unit's next destination.

title: Nothing Frozen, Nothing Gained
desc: The path to the Allhearken lies beyond a perilous region inhabited by enormous monsters, but the Hunter and company press on toward the road less traveled.

title: Through the Dusk
desc: After surviving the journey thanks to the combined efforts of the Hunter and Olivia, the party arrives at the home of the Allhearken.

title: A Path Forward
desc: The Allhearken bids Nata to see for himself just what it is that Arkveld seeks to become. But to understand Arkveld, one must first understand the Guardians. The Avis Unit pursues Arkveld, resolved to find those answers.

title: Full Circle
desc: The Allhearken bids Nata to see for himself just what it is that Arkveld seeks to become. But to understand Arkveld, one must first understand the Guardians. The Avis Unit pursues Arkveld, resolved to find those answers.

title: Full Circle
desc: The Allhearken bids Nata to see for himself just what it is that Arkveld seeks to become. But to understand Arkveld, one must first understand the Guardians. The Avis Unit pursues Arkveld, resolved to find those answers.

title: Dawn Breaks
desc: The Hunter learns of the immutable link between the Guardians and the surrounding lifeforms. The Avis Unit speculates that Arkveld too, has found a way back into the greater ecosystem.

title: Broken Chains
desc: The Hunter learns of the immutable link between the Guardians and the surrounding lifeforms, as Nata embraces the hope that Arkveld has slipped the Keepers' chains.

title: Visions of Hope
desc: Within the Dragontorch lurks Zoh Shia, Wyveria's secret weapon and ultimate Guardian. Stopping the torch would ensure the monster's demise—and the collapse of the entire ecosystem. Nata resolves to fulfill his duty as a Keeper as the Hunter stands beside him.

title: Monster Hunter
desc: Within the Dragontorch lurks Zoh Shia, Wyveria's secret weapon and ultimate Guardian. As Nata hesitates to fulfill his duty, the Hunter steps up and offers him a different solution. The time to slay Zoh Shia has arrived.

title: New Ecosystems
desc: Free of Zoh Shia's influence, the energy from the Dragontorch has put the entire Eastlands into a season of Plenty. The Avis Unit has been deployed to the Scarlet Forest to investigate. Excited for new discoveries, they advance further into the forest.

title: New Ecosystems
desc: Free of Zoh Shia's influence, the energy from the Dragontorch has put the entire Eastlands into a season of Plenty. The Avis Unit has been deployed to the Scarlet Forest to investigate. Excited for new discoveries, they advance further into the forest.

title: Chasing Change
desc: Through their investigation of the forest, Avis Unit has proven that the Eastlands' ecosystem is reverting to its natural state. Fabius asks the group to continue their investigation, but leaves the destination up to them.

title: Lurking Shadows
desc: New changes have hit the Wounded Hollow, an area near Suja that has been plagued by monsters since ancient times. After a council with Fabius and the Allhearken to establish their new objectives, the group departs to investigate the valley.

title: Lurking Shadows
desc: New changes have hit the Wounded Hollow, an area near Suja that has been plagued by monsters since ancient times. After a council with Fabius and the Allhearken to establish their new objectives, the group departs to investigate the valley.

title: Touring History
desc: After discovering a Frenzied Nerscylla in the Wounded Hollow, Fabius returns to the Academy to conduct a full analysis. Meanwhile, assuring the Allhearken that they'll monitor the situation, Avis Unit returns to their investigation.

title: Wyvern Sparks and Rose Thorns
desc: A Lala Barina was spotted in the Ruins of Wyveria, mysteriously far from its natural habitat. Under the assumption that it must possess abnormal traits, the potential harm to the region cannot be ignored. The Hunter departs to investigate at Olivia's behest.

title: Wyvern Sparks and Rose Thorns
desc: A Lala Barina was spotted in the Ruins of Wyveria, mysteriously far from its natural habitat. Under the assumption that it must possess abnormal traits, the potential harm to the region cannot be ignored. The Hunter departs to investigate at Olivia's behest.

title: Premonitions
desc: The appearance of a tempered monster attests to the major influence the Dragontorch's energy has on the region. Adding the Ruins of Wyveria to their list, Avis Unit once again sets out to investigate each area.

title: Omens
desc: Avis Unit receives another summons from Olivia, who is stationed at the Ruins of Wyveria. It appears to be especially urgent, so the Hunter sets off for the Base Camp there.

title: Storm-cold Vortex
desc: A tip from Nata clued the Hunter in on a frozen section of the Wyrmway. The cause seems related to the unending blizzards in the Iceshard Cliffs and the Jin Dahaad that resides there. The group ventures there, hoping to find a way to fix the flow of energy.

title: A World Turned Upside Down
desc: On top of a presumed connection between the excess energy from the Dragontorch and extreme weather conditions, Fabius reports that a Gore Magala is in the Eastlands. To address these simultaneous incidents, the Hunter has been tasked to go around and investigate each problem.

title: A Torrent of Energy
desc: Upon slaying the Jin Dahaad, the Landspine returns to its normal state. However, the Dragontorch continues to emit excessive amounts of energy. With this problem on their minds, Avis Unit continues to investigate the regions.

title: What Lies Ahead
desc: Against all odds, Arkveld has been reborn. While symbolizing the indomitability of nature, its very characteristics have ironically made it a force that cannot be ignored. Deducing that it will appear next at the Rey Dau's nest, the Hunter sets off.

title: What Lies Ahead
desc: Against all odds, Arkveld has been reborn. While symbolizing the indomitability of nature, its very characteristics have ironically made it a force that cannot be ignored. Deducing that it will appear next at the Rey Dau's nest, the Hunter sets off.

title: Healing Help
desc: Your Palico has requested that you capture Vigorwasps to help them test out their idea on a new recovery support move. It's sure to assist you in future hunts, so accept and help your Palico help you!

title: Flash Course
desc: Your Palico has requested that you capture Flashflies. This time, the words "spark of inspiration" were taken literally with an idea for a support move that'll blind monsters. Ready your capture net and capture the shining bugs to shed some light on your hunts!

title: A Gutsy Move
desc: Your Palico has requested that you capture Giant Vigorwasps. After much research and deliberation, your Palico finally found a solution to help you out even after you've been knocked flat. This one will really invigorate you!

title: Rath-from-Above, Go!
desc: Your Palico has requested that you hunt a Quematrice. Their confidence is really overflowing this time... What could they be up to? Well, if you want to know what they've got cooking, you better get out there!

title: Purrfect Plundering
desc: Your Palico has requested that you hunt a Guardian Ebony Odogaron. They said there's a new support move they want to try out. What is it? The best way to learn is by doing, so get out there!

title: Fishing: Life, in Microcosm
desc: A fishing request from Kanya. As she preaches, "No Fishing, No Life." Well...whether you agree or not, fishing is indeed a part of a hunter's lifestyle. When the fancy strikes, go drop a line and report to Kanya after you snag your first catch.

title: Seeking the Goldenfish
desc: Kanya, your unexpectedly appointed fisherfellow, has asked you to catch a Goldenfish. She's given you a special lure for it, so go put it to good use. You should be able to find this fish in dark pools, far from the light of the sun.

title: Fishing for Flavor
desc: Kanya has asked you to catch a Gravid Bowfin, known for its highly nutritious eggs. Catching a fish for this masterful fisherfellow could be a great way to show your appreciation!

title: The Catch of a Lifetime!
desc: Kanya has asked you to catch a whopper. While they say to use big bait for a big fish, it seems this one requires a bit more  technique to reel in. They always say, "The true worth of a fisher is to be measured by the whopper they pursue," so go to the Scarlet Forest and prove yours.

title: Razzle Dazzle
desc: A fishing request from Kanya. This time she wants you to catch an Escunite, some of which bear a dazzling shimmer. Apparently not even your experienced fisherfellow has glimpsed one before, so get out there and hook one to share in the joy of a new discovery.

title: Dareel's Research Report
desc: Dareel has asked you to catch one of the Tracktail Lizards that live in the Windward Plains. Apparently, it is particularly dire that he get it for his investigation on endemic life.

title: Samin's Research Report
desc: Samin has asked you to catch a Dapperwing, which lives in the Scarlet Forest. According to him, it isn't sporting of you to only help Dareel.

title: Dareel's Research Report (Cont.)
desc: As a second request, Dareel has asked you to catch an Ember Rufflizard from Oilwell Basin. Although it seems he has ulterior motives behind the request, it might be best to just help him out.

title: Samin's Research Report (Cont.)
desc: For Samin's follow-up request, he has asked you to find a Rime Beetle in the Iceshard Cliffs. He has firmly asserted that "THIS one is a proper investigation request." The more we know about endemic life the better, so let's lend him a hand.

title: Dareel's Special Research Report
desc: Now Dareel wants you to catch a rare Pillopod—also known as a Gillopod— from the Ruins of Wyveria. It seems this specimen blends in with normal Pillopods, but could be the result of a mutation.

title: Samin's Special Research Report
desc: Now Samin wants you to catch a Sandstar at the Windward Plains. Apparently it only appears at night and is quick to flee when spotted. Might be a tricky catch, but he seems actually serious this time.

title: High-Quality Materials
desc: Gemma has asked you to fetch high- quality monster materials. She seems pretty fired up about something, but said there's no rush. Bring some back for her whenever you find time.

title: Beware the Gypceros
desc: It was found that the monster wreaking havoc near Kunafa was a Gypceros. According to some information from Zatoh, the Gypceros in the Windward Plains only become active during the Fallow. Go and investigate when the opportunity to strike comes.

title: Smithy's Seal of Quality
desc: Gemma has invented a new hunting tool and is dying to get out on the field to test it out. It's sure to live up to expectations as always, so go and see what the hype is all about.

title: Make Fluffy Dealings
desc: According to Plumpeach, the change in the forest has allowed her beloved pink fur to grow strong and lush. If you accept and bring her Congalala fur, she will trade you something that may be of use in the future.

title: Aida's Apprehensions
desc: According to Aida, a Bonefolk child ran into a Rompopolo and was injured. It appears that cases such as this have been increasing, affecting both Azuz, and the surrounding ecosystem. It can no longer be ignored. Deal with the situation quickly before anyone else gets hurt.

title: Aberrant Atrocity
desc: It is suspected that the monster that attacked Rove in Iceshard Cliffs is a Yian Kut-Ku. Moreover, it appears to be more ferocious as a result of being away from its natural habitat. This matter must be investigated.

title: Secure Wounded Hollow
desc: Cobb says two Hirabami have been spotted in Wounded Hollow. They are a big threat to the safety of the nearby Keepers and must be dealt with. Make use of the fence that Gemma has repaired while on the hunt.

title: A Leviathan's Temper
desc: Based on Y'sai reports regarding the Vanguard's injuries, it appears to be the work of a Tempered Balahara. It must be hunted before anyone else gets hurt.

title: Forest Doshaguma
desc: Erik insists that you capture a Doshaguma from the Scarlet Forest that is "absolutely vital to the expansion of his comparative analysis of typical representations and alpha variants in the species." Go catch him one before he gets tempted to do it himself.

title: Succulent Scraps
desc: Dogard has reported that an unattended scrap pile of Oricalcite nearby attracted the attention of what is assumed to be a Gravios. It must be hunted before it brings any more harm to the village.

title: What We Protect
desc: Alma received a report that a survey team investigating relics in the Iceshard Cliffs accidentally entered a Blangonga's territory, sending it into a rage. It has become a danger too great to leave alone and must be hunted.

title: Werner's Test Run
desc: Werner claims to have created "a good one" this time. He apparently created something that utilizes the properties of Wyvern Milk. Take him along on a quest so he can test out the prototype.

title: Astonishing Adaptability
desc: Tasheen says a Xu Wu invaded the village, kidnapping a Keeper named Soshi. As this is an unprecedented event, the Guild decided to look into the matter immediately. While the reason for the attack is unknown, the Xu Wu must be hunted to ensure future safety.

title: As Gatekeeper
desc: Rex has reported two Ajarakan that have been spotted rampaging within Wounded Hollow. He has sent out a request for backup as his current priorities have left his hands tied. Make use of the fence as needed.

title: Continuing Conflict
desc: Murtabak reported two monsters fighting near Kunafa. It has been going on for days, and if left alone, could pose a  danger to the villagers. Go investigate, and take the necessary measures to ensure the safety of the village.

title: Fur Damagings Are Dislikeworthy
desc: Plumpeach has submitted a fur request. A Lala Barina and Congalala have been fighting in the Scarlet Forest, causing her great distress. "The fur is paying damagings! The ragings must be quelled!" A prompt hunt is requested to restore peace to us all.

title: Troublemakers
desc: Sabar says that monsters in the Oilwell Basin are impeding the miners' work. Judging from the available information, it appears to be particularly dangerous Gravios and Ajarakan. They are likely different from normal, so proceed with extra caution.

title: Echoing from the Cliffs
desc: According to Apar, some monsters have been raging in the Iceshard Cliffs, which is forcing the smaller monsters to run toward Suja. Head to the cliffs to hunt the Hirabami and Blangonga at its center.

title: The Struggle to Survive
desc: Rysher thinks he may have spotted a tempered monster in the Ruins of Wyveria. It seems the first sightings were a Xu Wu and a Guardian Ebony Odogaron. Go conduct an investigation to gauge the level of threat.

title: The Apple of Her Eye
desc: Alma lost her beloved glasses while investigating the Scarlet Forest. Perhaps the Wudwuds who were around know something.

title: Ultimate Strength
desc: Vespae Unit handler Quinn reports that there has been a significant decrease in sightings of tempered monsters in the Oilwell Basin. Search the middle and upper strata of the Oilwell Basin to see if you can find out what's going on.

title: New Fashion, Old Feelings
desc: Gemma calls upon the Hunter to help her put together a friendly fashion contest between the other units. Once each smithy decks their hunter out in the chosen Layered Armor, it's time to roll out the red carpet for "Project Fashion Hunter: Busting Down the Door to Progress"!

title: Purr-suing Ultimate Happiness
desc: The Hunter has heard of a Felyne who is craving for the ramen served at the Grand Hub. With mixed feelings, they offer their help to find the Poogie that's the key to reproducing that special flavor.

title: Love for a Hero
desc: Mina from Vespae Unit tells the Hunter that there has been an increase in especially ferocious Frenzied monsters, and that Nadia is investigating the matter. Mina offers to help, but for some reason Nadia keeps declining...

title: A Royal Request
desc: At the base camp in the Scarlet Forest, the Hunter meets the Royal Felyne Rudy from the kingdom of Azuria. Rudy claims to have misplaced some important eggs. The Hunter offers to bring them back.

title: Spirit in the Moonlight
desc: Rubrum Unit's Kanya reports that the Wudwuds' major source of food—fish— has been disrupted, likely by a monster. The group goes to speak with Mastangler to see what's wrong, and stumble upon something unexpected.

title: Spirit in the Moonlight
desc: Rubrum Unit's Kanya reports that the Wudwuds' major source of food—fish— has been disrupted, likely by a monster. The group goes to speak with Mastangler to see what's wrong, and stumble upon something unexpected.

title: A First Cry
desc: The Dragontorch that was blocked off following Zoh Shia's defeat is now mysteriously surrounded by cocoons. The group discovers that Zoh Shia has somehow been reborn and resolves to deal with the threat once more.

title: A First Cry
desc: The Dragontorch that was blocked off following Zoh Shia's defeat is now mysteriously surrounded by cocoons. The group discovers that Zoh Shia has somehow been reborn and resolves to deal with the threat once more.

title: Trembling Blue Currents
desc: According to reports from the Sandfolk, Flameborn, and Wudwuds, a recently agitated Rathalos has become an extreme threat. Erik insists that every action has a reason, and understanding it is paramount. Thus, the Hunter joins him to investigate what has the King of the Skies so worked up.

title: Trembling Blue Currents
desc: According to reports from the Sandfolk, Flameborn, and Wudwuds, a recently agitated Rathalos has become an extreme threat. Erik insists that every action has a reason, and understanding it is paramount. Thus, the Hunter joins him to investigate what has the King of the Skies so worked up.

title: Clear with a Chance of Sandstorm
desc: Young Nemmo and Vuno decided to do the Seikret rider's trial on their own. Nona and the Hunter set out to stop them, when a Seregios suddenly appears and makes off with a Seikret. Nona mounts up to give chase, with the Hunter hot on their trail.

title: Clear with a Chance of Sandstorm
desc: Young Nemmo and Vuno decided to do the Seikret rider's trial on their own. Nona and the Hunter set out to the plateau in the plains to stop them, when a Seregios suddenly appears and makes off with a Seikret. Nona mounts up to give chase, with the Hunter hot on their trail.

title: The Beacon of Invasion
desc: The talking artifact speaks: "Initiate invasion and subjugation." With these words, strange events begin to unfold in the Iceshard Cliffs—things the Hunter has never seen before.

title: The Beacon of Invasion
desc: The talking artifact speaks: "Initiate invasion and subjugation." With these words, strange events begin to unfold in the Iceshard Cliffs—things the Hunter has never seen before.

title: Invader from the Stars
desc: Omega Planetes appears from the mist, setting its sights on the one preventing it from finishing off Jin Dahaad.

title: Invader from the Stars
desc: Omega Planetes appears from the mist, setting its sights on the one preventing it from finishing off Jin Dahaad.

title: An Ancient Resting Place
desc: An expanse has been discovered deep beneath Azuz. To investigate this ancient space—which even the Flameborn have no memory of—Avis and Astrum Units head underground.

title: Ghosts Pay No Heed to Tomorrow
desc: Gogmazios has vanished like a ghost. Seizing this opportunity, the smithing team sets off to repair the Wyvern Milk energy nexus needed to operate an ancient weapon. Fearing for their safety, the Guild must nonetheless mobilize all its resources for the hard battle to come.
